entries.7592e0c3d50ddf23: Under the group mission 'Contributing to the "lives" and "livelihoods" of people around the world,' the company manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices, housing and building materials, and materials and components across its three domains of Healthcare, Homes and Materials. The company operates under a business holding company structure: under ASAHI KASEI CORPORATION, the business holding company, it has three business domains organized by product and service, and the business holding company and operating companies of each domain formulate domestic and overseas strategies and conduct business. It describes its distinctive feature as combining the diversity of its businesses (Diversity) with a high value-added business approach that emphasizes differentiation from competitors (Specialty).

entries.fc19ab2bb6d7d368: Ordinary profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥230.4 billion, up ¥37 billion from the previous fiscal year due to factors including higher equity-method investment income. Profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥158.8 billion. By segment profit (operating profit), Homes was the largest at ¥99.7 billion, followed by Healthcare at ¥83.4 billion and Materials at ¥68.3 billion. The company states that growth investment in the Homes and Healthcare domains bore fruit in profit, and that in fiscal 2025 the Homes domain became the domain with the largest operating profit.

entries.ff08baacaf8de706: This business makes lithium-ion battery separators, ion-exchange membranes, hollow fiber filtration membranes and other products. A separator is a membrane that separates the positive and negative electrodes inside a battery; it is manufactured by Asahi Kasei Battery Separator and by companies in Canada and the United States. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company states that it recognized indications of impairment on the assets of Asahi Kasei Battery Separator following slower growth in the electric vehicle market.
